title: The Agentic Loop and Where It Breaks
description: What plan-act-observe-revise actually is inside a coding agent, and the failure modes that are specific to running a chain of unattended actions rather than reviewing one completion.

title: Delegating Safely: Decomposition, Checkpoints, and Tool Access
description: Deciding which subtasks an agent can run unattended, where to place checkpoints in a chain you can't review step-by-step, and why granting tool and credential access is a scoped decision, not a default.

title: Running the Budget and Reviewing the Trajectory
description: Controlling cost and time on a multi-step run, recognizing when it has stopped making progress, and reviewing both what an agent produced and how it got there.
